content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a contractual bundling denial, not an authorization or medical-necessity denial, so retro authorization, another peer-to-peer, or a necessity appeal would not properly address it. Resubmission also risks an impermissible duplicate denial, and the patient cannot be billed beyond contractual liability. A human billing specialist must review the paid companion service and payer bundling/edit rules before the filing deadline."}
